visualCharacteristics.purpose: Toggle the tax situations that apply and see an estimated starting price

contentPattern.structure: Config rows keyed in the first cell: Prompt | question text; Result | result heading; Price | base price (e.g. $99); Note | price note (e.g. + additional state fee). Every other row is one situation: label | starting price when selected (optional) | CTA link (optional). Displayed price = highest of base and selected prices

usage: Product pricing pages where visitors pick their tax situations (tax-offices).
reuseGuidance: Reuse for the same content pattern; background colour comes from section metadata Style (forest, green, bright-green, eggshell, neon, white, black).
